about:
AirTrack Electronics Corporation, a contract electronics manufacturer, has operated from Meridian, Idaho since its founding in 2001. Located near Boise, the company was established to serve inventors, entrepreneurs, and engineers seeking to bring electronic and electro-mechanical products to market.

The shop handles electronic assembly, assembly modifications, rework, and updating, as well as mechanical assembly involving fasteners, adhesives, wire harnesses, and potting. Additional services include programming, testing, packaging, and prototype builds. Operating with a lean team, the company positions itself as a responsive partner for low- to medium-volume runs and welcomes prototype work.

Its customer base spans inventors, entrepreneurs, and engineers across industries requiring electronic and electro-mechanical manufacturing. The company works with clients from early prototyping through matured production runs.

AirTrack emphasizes flexibility, simplicity, and genuine care as its guiding principles. Quick turnaround times and a willingness to accommodate special requirements are cited as core strengths.
